'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 Delhi car explosion]]
**The [[National Investigation Agency]] of India states that the recent car explosion in [[Delhi]] was a [[suicide attack]] and report the arrest of a suspect accused of helping acquire and prepare the vehicle used in the blast. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/india-says-accomplice-delhi-car-blast-suicide-bomber-arrested-5470621 (AFP via CNA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least twelve people are killed and ten others are injured when a bus crashes in [[Tungurahua Province]], Ecuador. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bus-crash-ecuador-kills-least-12-people-2025-11-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[War on drugs in Ecuador]]
**Ecuadorian president [[Daniel Noboa]] announces that Spanish police have captured [[Los Lobos (gang)|Los Lobos]] leader Wilmer Chavarría, who faked his own death and changed his identity, in [[Málaga]], [[Andalusia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c93dz9zly83o (BBC News)]
*A [[Railway lines of Poland|broken railway line]] in the area of [[Życzyn]], [[Garwolin County]], in east central Poland is under police investigation as a possible act of sabotage. Two Ukrainian citizens have been identified as the suspects. [https://tvpworld.com/90048980/tusk-broken-railway-line-could-be-possible-sabotage (TVP World)][https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gknv8nxlzo (BBC)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Chilean general election]]
**[[2025 Chilean presidential election]]
***Chileans vote to elect their president, who will succeed the term-limited incumbent [[Gabriel Boric]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/11/15/americas/chile-presidential-election-explainer-latam-intl (CNN)]
***Preliminary results indicate a second round between [[Jeannette Jara]] and [[José Antonio Kast]] on 13 December. [https://elpais.com/chile/2025-11-16/resultados-de-las-elecciones-presidenciales-en-chile-2025-en-vivo.html (''El País'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]
**Also up for election are the whole [[Chamber of Deputies of Chile|Chamber of Deputies]] and half of the [[Senate of Chile|Senate]]. [https://www.adnradio.cl/2025/11/16/resultados-elecciones-2025-en-chile-revisa-la-lista-de-todos-los-diputados-y-senadores-ganadores-y-cuando-asumen-sus-cargos/ (Radio ADN <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*{{ill|2025 Ecuadorian referendum|es|Referéndum constitucional y consulta popular de Ecuador de 2025|fr|Référendum constitutionnel équatorien de 2025}}
**Ecuadorians vote on a [[2008 Constitution of Ecuador|constitutional]] referendum, on foreign military bases, on public financing of political parties and the number of [[National Assembly (Ecuador)|assembly members]], and on a popular consultation about the convocation of an [[constituent assembly]]. All 4 were rejected. [https://elpais.com/america/2025-11-17/el-primer-gran-reves-de-noboa-ecuador-dice-no-a-todas-sus-reformas-constitucionales.html (El País <small>in Spanish</small>)]

*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**Iranian foreign minister [[Abbas Araghchi]] says that Iran is no longer [[Enriched uranium|enriching uranium]] due, in part, to the damage at [[Nuclear facilities in Iran|nuclear facilities]] following the [[Iran–Israel war]] and the [[United States strikes on Iranian nuclear sites|US strikes on nuclear sites]] in Iran. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-nuclear-enrichment-c0079c38746a896e2967a9a9cc2799d5 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 ATP Tour]]
**[[2025 ATP Finals]]
***In tennis, [[Jannik Sinner]] defeats his rival [[Carlos Alcaraz]] in the final, 7–6<sup>(7–4)</sup>, 7–5, to successfully defend his [[2025 ATP Finals – Singles|singles]] title at the 2025 [[ATP Finals]]. [https://cebudailynews.inquirer.net/670437/sinner-beats-great-rival-alcaraz-to-retain-atp-finals-title (AFP via ''Cebu Daily News'')]
*[[2025 CFL season]]
**[[112th Grey Cup]]
***In [[Canadian football]], the [[Saskatchewan Roughriders]] defeat the [[Montreal Alouettes]] 25–17 to win their fifth [[Grey Cup]]. [https://www.tsn.ca/cfl/article/roughriders-claim-112th-grey-cup-over-alouettes/ (TSN)]
